# sreagent_alert_routes (Data Source)

Every alert_route row, read-only. Where one service's alerts open in Slack.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_alert_routes" "all" {}

output "alert_routes_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_alert_routes.all.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is in force.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `oncall_schedule_id` (String) An on-call schedule whose current person is mentioned in the alert's thread. Removing it clears the mention.
- `service` (String) The service whose alerts this routes. Changing it replaces the route.
- `target` (String) The Slack channel this service's alerts open in.
